subject: Missed discovery — quick options to rebook
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@finpulse.com>
Cc: Emily Barnes <ebarnes@finpulse.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery call — Redwood Inference x FinPulse (Jun 29 4:00 PM PT)

Hi Carlos / Emily,

Thanks for scheduling some time — confirming our 30-minute discovery on Tue, Jun 29 at 4:00 PM PT. Agenda:
- Quick intro (5 min)
- Your current inference stack and pain points (10–12 min)
- How Redwood typically helps teams reduce latency/cost (8 min)
- Next steps / pilot approach (5 min)

I've attached a short discovery questionnaire that helps us focus the call. If anything changes, you can reschedule here: https://calendly.com/redwood-aditya/30min

Look forward to it —

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: discovery-questionnaire.docx (stated contents: 6 questions, approximate workload samples)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@finpulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Emily Barnes <ebarnes@finpulse.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Missed: Discovery call — Redwood Inference x FinPulse (we missed you)

Carlos —

I popped into the call at 4:00 PM PT but didn’t see you on the bridge. I left a quick voicemail on your mobile. No worries — totally understand schedules get slammed. Two quick options to rebook: 

1) Pick a new slot on my calendar (fastest): https://calendly.com/redwood-aditya/30min
2) If you prefer, reply with 2 windows that work this week and I’ll lock one in.

If it helps, Marissa (AE) is cc’d and can join to go deeper on product fit / ROI examples if we lock a time.

Short ask in the meantime — if you can reply with an example of current token volumes or cost target, that helps us prepare (one line is fine).

Cheers,
Aditya
SDR, Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.inference)

Note: I also dropped a log in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/FP-20270630-01 (call outcome = no-show).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@finpulse.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Emily Barnes <ebarnes@finpulse.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T16:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed: Discovery call — Redwood Inference x FinPulse (we missed you)

Sorry we missed you, Carlos — hope everything is OK. If it helps to move faster on prep, here are two concrete options from my side:
• Wed 6/30 — 10:30–11:00 AM PT
• Thu 7/1 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Carlos, either of those work for you? If not, pick any slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-aditya/30min and we’ll adjust. Quick agenda for a first call if you pick one of my slots:
- 10 min: your infra & goals
- 10 min: Redwood approach (latency/cost examples)
- 10 min: mutual next steps

I attached our one-pager that summarizes the typical deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — might be useful to share with your infra team.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0170

Attachment: product-one-pager.pdf (1 page summary of products and typical latency/cost outcomes)

From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@finpulse.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Emily Barnes <ebarnes@finpulse.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed: Discovery call — Redwood Inference x FinPulse (we missed you)

Hi Aditya / Marissa —

Apologies, I had an urgent client issue come up and couldn’t make the call yesterday. Thanks for following up and for the voicemail. Either of Marissa’s times would work for me — Wed 6/30 at 10:30 AM PT is best.

Quick context for the call so you can prep:
- We run in-house inference for a recommendation model (NLP) — 1M tokens/day, peak concurrency ~70 requests/s.
- Our current infra is a mixed fleet (k8s + managed GPUs) and costs are ~ $18k/month.
- Top goals: reduce 95th pct latency, explore cheaper quantized variants if possible, and evaluate options for a private deployment later this year.

Would appreciate if you can send that one-pager ahead of the call (I missed the attachment earlier) and any short notes on typical SLOs customers see.

Thanks — see you Wed 10:30.

Carlos Vega
Head of ML Engineering, FinPulse
carlos.vega@finpulse.com | (415) 555-0999
